_meta.note: Hand-curated from the official SASB PDFs. Topic summaries paraphrased; metrics are verbatim from the standard's Table 1 (Sustainability Disclosure Topics & Metrics).

Commercial Banks.description: Commercial banks accept deposits and make loans to individuals and corporations. The industry's material ESG issues centre on data security, fair lending, ESG factors in credit decisions, financed emissions, and systemic risk.

topics.name: Data Security
topics.summary: Banks hold large volumes of personal financial data; breaches damage revenue and customer trust.

metrics.name: Number of data breaches; percentage personal data breaches; account holders affected
Description of approach to identifying and addressing data security risks

topics.name: Financial Inclusion & Capacity Building
topics.summary: Lending to unbanked, underbanked or underserved customers — the bank's primary social impact lever.

metrics.name: Number and amount of loans outstanding qualifying for small business and community development programmes
Number and amount of past-due/nonaccrual qualifying loans
Number of no-cost retail checking accounts for previously unbanked/underbanked customers
Number of participants in financial literacy initiatives

topics.name: Incorporation of ESG Factors in Credit Analysis
topics.summary: How the bank embeds environmental, social and governance considerations into lending decisions.

metrics.name: Description of approach to ESG factors in credit analysis

topics.name: Financed Emissions
topics.summary: Greenhouse gas emissions associated with the bank's lending and investment portfolio — usually orders of magnitude larger than operational emissions.

metrics.name: Absolute gross financed emissions, by Scope 1, 2, 3
Gross exposure for each industry by asset class
Percentage of gross exposure included in financed emissions calculation
Description of methodology for financed emissions

topics.name: Business Ethics
topics.summary: Conduct risk: fraud, insider trading, antitrust, market manipulation, malpractice.

metrics.name: Total monetary losses from legal proceedings (industry conduct)
Description of whistleblower policies and procedures

topics.name: Systemic Risk Management
topics.summary: The bank's contribution to and management of systemic financial risk.

metrics.name: Global Systemically Important Bank (G-SIB) score, by category
Description of approach to integrating stress test results into capital adequacy planning

activity_metrics.name: Number and value of checking and savings accounts (personal, small business)
Number and value of loans (personal, small business, corporate)

Asset Management & Custody Activities.description: Asset managers and custodians hold and invest client assets. Material issues centre on transparent advice, ESG integration, financed emissions of the portfolio, and conduct.

topics.name: Transparent Information & Fair Advice for Customers
topics.summary: Fiduciary duty: are clients receiving clear, suitable advice?

metrics.name: Number/percentage of licensed employees with regulatory investigations or complaints
Total monetary losses from legal proceedings (marketing/communication)
Description of approach to informing customers about products

topics.name: Employee Diversity & Inclusion
topics.summary: Gender and diversity representation across executive, management and professional roles.

metrics.name: Percentage gender and diversity representation by role tier

topics.name: Incorporation of ESG Factors in Investment Management & Advisory
topics.summary: How ESG considerations are integrated into investment processes and advice.

metrics.name: AUM employing ESG integration, themed investing, and screening
Description of approach to incorporating ESG factors
Description of proxy voting and investee engagement policies

topics.name: Financed Emissions
topics.summary: Emissions associated with assets under management — the dominant climate footprint for asset managers.

metrics.name: Absolute gross financed emissions, by Scope 1, 2, 3
Total AUM included in financed emissions disclosure
Percentage of total AUM included
Description of financed emissions methodology

topics.name: Business Ethics
topics.summary: Conduct risk: fraud, insider trading, antitrust, market manipulation.

metrics.name: Total monetary losses from legal proceedings (industry conduct)
Description of whistleblower policies and procedures

activity_metrics.name: Total assets under custody and supervision

Insurance.description: Insurance entities underwrite risk for individuals and businesses. Material issues span fair customer treatment, ESG integration in invested assets, climate-related physical risk, and systemic risk.

topics.name: Transparent Information & Fair Advice for Customers
topics.summary: Clarity of policy terms and product suitability — drives complaints, churn, and regulatory action.

metrics.name: Total monetary losses from legal proceedings (marketing/communication)
Complaints-to-claims ratio
Customer retention rate
Description of approach to informing customers about products

topics.name: Incorporation of ESG Factors in Investment Management
topics.summary: Insurers' general accounts hold large investment portfolios; ESG integration matters there too.

metrics.name: Description of approach to ESG factors in investment management

topics.name: Policies Designed to Incentivise Responsible Behaviour
topics.summary: Underwriting design that rewards sustainability — e.g. low-carbon technology, health, safety.

metrics.name: Net premiums written related to energy efficiency and low-carbon technology
Discussion of products that incentivise sustainable behaviour

topics.name: Financed Emissions
topics.summary: Emissions associated with the insurer's investment portfolio.

metrics.name: Absolute gross financed emissions, by Scope 1, 2, 3
Gross exposure for each industry by asset class
Percentage of gross exposure included in financed emissions calculation
Description of financed emissions methodology

topics.name: Physical Risk Exposure
topics.summary: Climate-related catastrophic risk to the underwriting book — the insurer's defining ESG exposure.

metrics.name: Probable Maximum Loss (PML) of insured products from weather-related natural catastrophes
Total monetary losses from insurance pay-outs from natural catastrophes
Description of approach to environmental risks in underwriting and capital adequacy

topics.name: Systemic Risk Management
topics.summary: The insurer's contribution to and management of systemic financial risk.

metrics.name: Exposure to derivative instruments by category
Total fair value of securities lending collateral assets
Description of approach to managing systemic non-insurance activities

activity_metrics.name: Number of policies in force, by segment (P&C, life, assumed reinsurance)

Real Estate.description: Real estate entities own, develop and operate property. Material issues centre on energy and water in buildings, tenant impact, and climate adaptation.

topics.name: Energy Management
topics.summary: Buildings are large energy consumers; performance affects operating costs, regulatory exposure, and tenant demand.

metrics.name: Energy consumption data coverage as % of total floor area, by property sector
Total energy consumed; % grid electricity; % renewable, by property sector
Like-for-like % change in energy consumption
% of eligible portfolio with energy rating and ENERGY STAR certification
Description of energy management integration into investment analysis

topics.name: Water Management
topics.summary: Water use, especially in regions of high baseline water stress.

metrics.name: Water withdrawal data coverage as % of total floor area; % in High/Extremely High water stress regions
Total water withdrawn; % in High/Extremely High water stress regions
Like-for-like % change in water withdrawn
Description of water management risks and mitigation

topics.name: Management of Tenant Sustainability Impacts
topics.summary: Owner influence over tenant resource use through lease structure and submetering.

metrics.name: % of new leases with cost-recovery clause for resource-efficiency capex; associated leased floor area
% of tenants separately metered/submetered for electricity and water
Discussion of approach to tenant sustainability impact

topics.name: Climate Change Adaptation
topics.summary: Physical climate risk to the property portfolio — flood zones, exposure analysis.

metrics.name: Area of properties located in 100-year flood zones, by property sector
Description of climate change risk exposure and mitigation

activity_metrics.name: Number of assets, by property sector
Leasable floor area, by property sector
% of indirectly managed assets, by property sector
Average occupancy rate, by property sector

Metals & Mining.description: Mining operations are energy-intensive, water-intensive and land-intensive. Material issues span emissions, biodiversity, tailings, human rights, and worker safety.

topics.name: Greenhouse Gas Emissions
topics.summary: Direct emissions from fuel use during mining, ore processing and smelting.

metrics.name: Gross global Scope 1 emissions; % covered under emissions-limiting regulations
Discussion of strategy to manage Scope 1 emissions and targets

topics.name: Air Quality
topics.summary: Non-GHG air pollutants — particulates, NOx, SOx, mercury, lead, VOCs.

metrics.name: Air emissions: CO, NOx, SOx, PM10, mercury, lead, VOCs

topics.name: Energy Management
topics.summary: Total energy consumption and the share from grid electricity vs renewables.

metrics.name: Total energy consumed; % grid electricity; % renewable

topics.name: Water Management
topics.summary: Water-intensive operations, often in water-stressed regions.

metrics.name: Total water withdrawn; total water consumed; % in High/Extremely High water stress regions
Number of incidents of non-compliance with water quality permits

topics.name: Waste & Hazardous Materials Management
topics.summary: Tailings, waste rock, hazardous waste — long-term liabilities and incident risk.

metrics.name: Total weight of non-mineral waste generated
Total weight of tailings produced
Total weight of waste rock generated
Total weight of hazardous waste generated
Total weight of hazardous waste recycled
Number of significant incidents associated with hazardous materials and waste
Description of waste and hazardous materials management policies

topics.name: Biodiversity Impacts
topics.summary: Ecological footprint of mining sites; acid rock drainage; protected/endangered habitat.

metrics.name: Description of environmental management policies for active sites
% of mine sites where acid rock drainage is predicted, mitigated, or under remediation
% of proved/probable reserves in or near sites with protected conservation status or endangered species habitat

topics.name: Security, Human Rights & Rights of Indigenous Peoples
topics.summary: Reserves in conflict zones or on indigenous land; rights-based engagement.

metrics.name: % of proved/probable reserves in or near areas of conflict
% of proved/probable reserves in or near indigenous land
Discussion of human rights, indigenous rights, and conflict-area engagement

topics.name: Workforce Health & Safety
topics.summary: Mining is a high-hazard industry; injury and fatality rates are headline metrics.

metrics.name: All-incidence rate, fatality rate, near miss frequency rate, average hours of training

topics.name: Tailings Storage Facilities Management
topics.summary: Tailings dam safety — catastrophic-loss risk that has reshaped the industry post-Brumadinho.

metrics.name: Tailings storage facility inventory table (location, capacity, hazard classification, etc.)
Summary of tailings management systems and governance
Approach to development of Emergency Preparedness and Response Plans

activity_metrics.name: Production of metal ores and finished metal products

Electric Utilities & Power Generators.description: Electricity generation is the world's largest source of GHG emissions. Material issues span emissions, air quality, water, customer affordability, grid reliability, and nuclear safety where applicable.

topics.name: Greenhouse Gas Emissions & Energy Resource Planning
topics.summary: GHG emissions from generation are the single largest material issue for the industry.

metrics.name: Gross global Scope 1 emissions; % under emissions-limiting/reporting regulations
GHG emissions associated with power deliveries
Discussion of strategy to manage Scope 1 emissions, targets, performance

topics.name: Air Quality
topics.summary: Non-GHG air pollutants from combustion plants — health-affecting in dense population areas.

metrics.name: Air emissions: NOx, SOx, PM10, lead, mercury; % near dense population

topics.name: Water Management
topics.summary: Cooling water and process water — material in arid and water-stressed regions.

metrics.name: Total water withdrawn; total water consumed; % in High/Extremely High water stress regions
Number of incidents of non-compliance with water quality permits
Description of water management risks and mitigation

topics.name: Coal Ash Management
topics.summary: Coal combustion product handling and recycling — a legacy environmental liability.

metrics.name: Amount of coal combustion products (CCPs) generated; % recycled
Description of CCP management policies

topics.name: Energy Affordability
topics.summary: Customer affordability and access — disconnections, reconnection rates, retail rates.

metrics.name: Average retail electric rate (residential, commercial, industrial)
Number of residential disconnections for non-payment; % reconnected within 30 days
Discussion of impact of external factors on customer affordability

topics.name: Workforce Health & Safety
topics.summary: High-hazard industry; injury and fatality rates are tracked alongside training hours.

metrics.name: Total recordable incident rate (TRIR), fatality rate, near miss frequency rate

topics.name: End-Use Efficiency & Demand
topics.summary: Demand-side management — smart grid coverage, customer efficiency programmes.

metrics.name: % of electric load served by smart grid technology
Customer electricity savings from efficiency measures, by market

topics.name: Nuclear Safety & Emergency Management
topics.summary: For utilities with nuclear assets — safety review status and emergency preparedness.

metrics.name: Total number of nuclear power units, broken down by safety review results
Description of nuclear safety and emergency preparedness

topics.name: Grid Resiliency
topics.summary: Outage frequency and duration; physical and cybersecurity compliance.

metrics.name: Number of incidents of non-compliance with physical/cybersecurity standards
SAIDI, SAIFI, CAIDI inclusive of major event days

activity_metrics.name: Number of customers served (residential, commercial, industrial)
Total electricity delivered, by customer class
Length of transmission and distribution lines
Total electricity generated, % by major energy source, % in regulated markets
